svg.title: Albury seven-table speakeasy and backstage furniture plan
svg.desc: Main bar approximately sixty by thirty-eight feet, with an adjoining ten-by-twelve-foot backstage store and preparation room north of the permanent raised stage, connected by a fixed landing. Instrument storage, mirror and bench are in the back room. Seven small cafe tables replace the navy sofa and poker table. Billiards stays southwest; shuffleboard moves south behind it. Bar remains east; permanent raised stage and piano remain north.
svg.text: Permanent raised stage, piano retained — current room configuration

The permanent stage and backstage room stay in place in every mode. Main bar: approx. 60 × 38 ft.
